## Passages
RESULT [attribution]: Scales to 1 million samples in under 2.25 hours on a single CPU. Outperforms existing data valuation methods at finding mislabeled data and at finding beneficial or harmful data subsets across 12 classification datasets.
US [attribution]: This is a cheap per-crop valuation for the labeller agent's classification step. With frozen BioCLIP-2/DINOv2 embeddings of crops from the new batch, a bagged linear probe gives an out-of-bag value per crop, and low values flag probable wrong species labels before they enter detector training. It does not value images for the detector itself.
CORRECTION [attribution]: None needed. Under 2.25 h on a single CPU for 10^6 samples (input dim 100). It outperforms state-of-the-art methods at finding mislabeled data and helpful or harmful subsets on 12 classification datasets. ICML 2023 confirmed.
